name: lifting-core
description: Pure strength-training plans: planned exercises with their progression rule, workouts in cycle order, the prescription a lifter works at, logged sets grouped into sessions, the increment / hold / deload decision and the StrongLifts 5x5 template — plus, behind the `lifting-core/fhir` subpath, the FHIR R4 `PlanDefinition` / `ServiceRequest` / `Observation` adapters. No DOM, no platform imports.
